courses.title: Statistical Modelling for Field Research
courses.description: Statistical Modelling for Field Research takes you from the basics of statistical modelling to applying it on a realistic Conservation Programme Manager scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to stakeholder engagement, enough to use it alongside statistical modelling day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying statistical modelling to a real Conservation Programme Manager scenario
Practicing statistical modelling through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to stakeholder engagement
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Grant Writing
courses.description: Applying Grant Writing is a focused course on grant writing for people already working toward a Conservation Programme Manager role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying grant writing on your own.

Practicing grant writing through guided exercises
Building a short grant writing exercise from scratch

courses.title: Getting Started with Geospatial Mapping
courses.description: Getting Started with Geospatial Mapping is a short introduction to geospatial mapping for people moving toward a Conservation Programme Manager role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show geospatial mapping in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if geospatial mapping is new to you.

alternates.title: Statistical Modelling Essentials
alternates.description: Statistical Modelling Essentials walks you through the basics of statistical modelling, built for people new to Conservation Programme Manager work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of statistical modelling, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying statistical modelling to a real Conservation Programme Manager scenario
Practicing statistical modelling through guided exercises

alternates.title: Advanced Statistical Modelling Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Statistical Modelling Techniques goes beyond the basics of statistical modelling, for people already working toward a Conservation Programme Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in statistical modelling and want to go further.
